description.text: Study ObiectiveThe educational objective of this program is to train students into communications engineers, who can use the principles and theories of communications to solve technical problems in research and application.Main coursesAdvanced Mathmatics; General Chemistry; Introduction to Computing; Engineering Drawing; Advanced Mathmatics; C Programing; Practice of Eectronic Knowledge; Physics Lab; Programming Design Lab; Electronic Process Practice;Internship and Career Development This program values the combining of theory and practice, so the practical projects driven studies are encouraged and supported while taking the professional courses.Students may be employed in all sorts of communications and electronic related industries upon graduation: Information acquirement and security related companies, such as digital camera producing companies, information security related companies, security department in bank and other companies, security department in governments, etc. Information transmission related companies, such as communications equipment manufacturing companies (cell phone manufacturing companies, digital TV manufacturing companies), communication network operator companies, multimedia communications companies, etc. Information processing related companies, such as Internet service providers (ISP), consumer electronic companies. They can also move into other areas such as entrepreneurship and consulting. Another developing opportunity is in sales engineering and technical service. This involves the service and testing functions for various types of equipment in the industry.Diploma AwardedBachelor of EngineeringFurther StudyGraduates with bachelor's degrees in Communications Engineering enjoy an advantage when applying for a master's degree program. Some with excellent performance during undergraduate study could be directly admited without any examinations

duration.text: The Telecommunication Engineering at Shenyang Aerospace University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.2. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.3. Academic transcript of high school4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.5. Sponsorship Certificate

requirements.text: 1. Applicants shall be younger than 25 years old.2. Applicants shall achieve a high school diploma or equivalent
